_doc.note:
Character feature banks. Identity pools (face_shapes, hair, eyes, nose, marks, face_detail, build, demeanor) hold objects: {text, age?, sex?, race?}. Tags are SOFT AFFINITIES, never filters — draws are weighted 4 (match) / 2 (untagged) / 1 (mismatch) per axis and multiplied across axes: one stated identity, individually exclusive details, tiny randomization in every draw. The identity itself (age/sex/race words) is stated once in the identity phrase by the roller. complexion is race-keyed phrases (drawn at detail=high). postures/positions are geometry, untagged strings. _compose groups rebuild a phrase from orthogonal slots (set × shape × color) the way the legacy regex did — slot options carry the same soft affinity tags. Expand the banks, not the code.

Detail split (2026-08-27): face_detail gates the face ladder, body_detail the body (minimal = one guaranteed build word — portrait companion; low = wide-shot; high = garment ladder). Five new flat banks — mouth, jaw, cheekbones, brow, ears — absorbed their strays from face_detail, which is now whole-face misc (lines, texture, flush, birthmarks); _compose.face_detail rebuilt to match. Phrase budget: a high face samples ~6 phrases total, never the inventory.
_doc.physique: build = clean archetypes, the physique parent; drawn flat (canonical text is the key children tag on). physique children carry BOTH identity tags and a 'build' axis of soft multipliers keyed on the drawn parent value — influenced, never exclusive. body_type node input forces the parent (default random). children gates: low=torso .25; high=torso .6/legs .5/arms .4. _compose.build retired (parent must stay canonical).
